fragments.text: GaugeCL fails to include rollover rewards in rate calculation for new periods, causing permanent undistribution

While I was reviewing the reward distribution logic in GaugeCL, I notice a bug. The code fetches `clPool.rollover()` and adds it to calculate `totalRewardAmount`, then passes this value to `rewardReserve`. But when I looked at the `rewardRate` calculation, it only uses `rewardAmount`. That felt wrong.
I compared this to the else branch (when continuing an existing period):

The else branch properly includes `pendingRewards` in the rate calculation. So why doesn't the if branch include the rollover? They serve the same purpose - both represent undistributed rewards that should be part of the new rate.
Looking at CLPool.sol, rollover accumulates when there's no staked liquidity to receive rewards:
And here's the kicker - `syncReward()` explicitly deletes the rollover:
If rollover wasn't meant to be distributed in the new period, why delete it?
Let's say Week 1 has no staked liquidity. All 1000 HYBR emissions roll over. Then Week 2 starts with liquidity staked and another 1000 HYBR comes in.
Users only get half the rewards they should. The rollover persists but never gets distributed because each new period makes the same mistake.
I ran some math and realized if this pattern continues, rollover just grows infinitely. That's not sustainable and definitely breaks the emission model the protocol designed.
**Paste the POC code below into C4Poc.t.sol and run the command `forge test --mt test_M01_RolloverNotIncludedInRateCalculation -vvv`
